jobs.title: Pricing and Revenue Data Science Senior Manager - Consumer Markets Sector
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a Pricing and Revenue Data Science Senior Manager - Consumer Markets Sector, you will leverage advanced analytics techniques to help clients optimize their operations and achieve strategic goals. Within our Commercial & Service Excellence practice, you will focus on utilizing advanced analytical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. You will apply skills in data manipulation, visualization, and statistical modeling to support clients in solving complex business problems.

As a Senior Manager, you will grow as a strategic advisor, using your influence, skills, and network to deliver quality results. You will motivate and coach others, collaborating to solve complex problems. With increased autonomy, you will apply sound judgment, recognizing when to take action and when to escalate. Your ability to develop and sustain high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, along with your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our firm.

In this role, you will craft and convey clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story, apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems, and validate outcomes with clients. You will direct teams through complexity, demonstrating composure in ambiguous situations, and initiate open and honest coaching conversations at all levels.

Responsibilities

Leading data-driven initiatives to optimize pricing and revenue strategies within the consumer markets sector
Utilizing advanced analytics techniques to extract insights from large datasets and support strategic decision-making
Developing and implementing data models and predictive analytics to forecast market trends and customer behavior
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate data insights into business operations and drive performance improvements
Managing the creation and maintenance of dashboards and data visualizations to communicate complex data insights effectively
Overseeing data quality and integrity to support accurate analysis and reporting
Applying systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities within data processes
Directing teams through complex data analysis projects, maintaining composure in ambiguous situations
Validating outcomes with clients and incorporating feedback to refine data solutions
Initiating coaching conversations to develop high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 7 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Engineering, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Computer and Information Science, Economics, Finance
At least one of the following: a Certification in databases (Databricks, MS SQL), visualization tools (Power BI), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), or predictive modeling/ML (Python, SAS)
Leading revenue growth strategies through advanced data science, pricing, and promotion optimization
Demonstrating advanced skills in data analysis and visualization
Leading complex data-driven projects in consumer markets
Utilizing AI and machine learning for predictive analytics
Excelling in strategic advising and client interaction
Developing and coaching high-performing, diverse teams

The salary range for this position is: $124,000 - $280,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law.

Learn more about how we work: https://pwc.to/how-we-work

jobs.title: CATIA Design Engineer - Mechanical CAD
jobs.description:
Position: CATIA Design Engineer - Mechanical CAD

Location: Remote

Key Responsibilities

Create, modify, and develop 3D CAD models using CATIA.
Design mechanical components, parts, and assemblies.
Work on part design, assembly modeling, and surface modeling.
Prepare and modify engineering drawings.
Explain and document CAD design workflows step by step.
Review engineering tasks and ensure technical accuracy.
Provide feedback to help improve AI systems' understanding of CAD and mechanical design.

Required Qualifications

Professional, hands-on experience using CATIA.
Strong understanding of mechanical design and CAD engineering principles.
Practical experience with 3D CAD modeling.
Good knowledge of mechanical part design and assembly modeling.
Understanding of surface modeling and engineering drawings.
Ability to explain technical workflows and engineering decisions clearly.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Excellent written communication and technical documentation abilities.
Must currently have access to CATIA software.

Preferred Qualifications

Educational background in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Experience working on professional mechanical design or CAD engineering projects.
Exposure to industrial product development, component design, or mechanical assemblies.
Experience interpreting engineering specifications and design requirements.
Ability to independently complete technical assignments and maintain high-quality deliverables.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Congressional Affairs Support, Enterprise & with Security Clearance
jobs.description:
Senior Data Analyst, Congressional Affairs Support Location Arlington, VA Clearance Level Top Secret/SCI Clearance Required Job Code 1303 Gemini Industries Inc. provides technical, management and operations services to support National Security projects. We provide rapid response to the critical needs of our customers and those they serve. We perform analyses and develop operations plans to anticipate and prepare for the future. And we deliver advanced technology to improve our customer’s success in executing its mission. Gemini seeks innovative, results-oriented individuals with the creativity, initiative, and intelligence to overcome any challenge and succeed. Members of the Gemini team thrive in a culture that is anticipatory, agile, and schedule-driven; with a sense of urgency and a drive to succeed. Our culture involves:

The best and brightest personnel
Work at a high operations tempo
Integrated teams delivering rapid solutions
An attitude that balances “I can make it better” with “As long as we succeed” Senior Data Analyst, Congressional Affairs Support Location: Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia Clearance: Top Secret / SCI Education: Bachelor’s degree in data science, data analytics, computer science, or similar quantitative field; or equivalent experience Outcomes: The successful candidate is expected to accomplish the following outcomes the first year in the position:
Utilizes statistical methods and analytical tools to interpret complex data sets, identifying trends, patterns, and insights that can inform business strategies which leads to positive Government performance feedback. Responsibilities: The Headquarters United States Space Force (HQ USSF) and the Director of Staff (HQSF/DS) require assistance in organizational planning, implementation, maturation, and strengthening of the HQ Space Force. To further the process of developing HQ USSF, a multi-faceted planning, integration, and management support team continues to implement a multi-phased, (multi-year), plan to transition HQ USSF from an initial operating capacity to full operational capacity. The Senior Data Analyst for Congressional Affairs Support will lead these efforts by performing the following functions:
Support ongoing USSF Congressional Affairs staffing efforts.
Support with supporting ongoing USSF stand-up, implementation planning efforts, support Space Force culture design and enablement related to Congressional Affairs functions.
Plan and develop knowledge management (KM) in Palantir Foundry, Microsoft SharePoint, and CRM systems.
Develop and maintain Extract Transform Load (ETL) pipelines.
Maintain and upkeep KM systems.
Develop and maintain dashboards and applications.
Create comprehensive reports and visualizations to present findings to senior Department of the Air Force (DAF) officials and other stakeholders, translating complex data into understandable formats.
Track key performance indicators to assess the effectiveness of Congressional engagements and business processes, and recommend improvements based on data insights.
Support development and implementation of the DAF’s Congressional Engagement Strategy. Qualifications: The candidate must have the following qualifications:
Top Secret / SCI security clearance bachelor’s degree in data science, data analytics, computer science, or similar quantitative field.
10-15 years of experience with data analysis and data architecture development.
Knowledge of DevOps principles, data governance, and data QA/QC.
Palantir Foundry experience and/or proficiency with other data operating systems (Snowflake, Databricks)
Experience building automated CI/CD ETL pipelines.
Skilled in GIS and geospatial data analysis.
Proficiency with SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark).
LLM integration (embedding, RAG) experience
Experience with Power BI and other data visualization tools.
Analytical abilities to interpret data and derive actionable insights, along with attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Highly Desired Requirements: Experience leveraging cloud-based databasing, ETL, and data visualization solutions to support data-driven decision making.
Degree in data science, data analytics, computer science, or similar quantitative field.
Palantir Foundry certification.
Knowledge of MLOps principles.
Proficiency with supervised and unsupervised ML (scikit-learn, PyTorch).
Typescript proficiency
Proven experience developing well-designed reports and briefings for executive leadership.
Legislative/Congressional affairs experience. We seek:
Highly-motivated self-starters that have Subject Matter Expertise in AI systems and organizational business models to obtain ongoing efficiencies in Congressional Affairs staffing processes.
A general understanding of Department of War (DoW) staffing procedures involving task management systems and other systems to effectively find efficiencies in managing specific USSF programs and initiatives.
Resourceful individuals with extraordinary intellectual capability and the ability to rapidly learn and apply new concepts.
Individuals who have a “let me try” attitude and are resilient, present an opinion/position, justify it, and then accept whatever decision is made and charge forward.
Individuals who view criticism as an opportunity to improve (“let me try again”) as part of a Team focused effort supporting the advancement of cutting-edge space operations.
Individuals who think and create, enhancing the company with a steady flow of fresh ideas, perspective, and energy to meet ever evolving DoW requirements tied to national defense.
Highly proficient with using an array of Microsoft office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OneNote, SharePoint, Teams) required. We will provide the U.S. Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s Form I‑9 to confirm work authorization. For more information on E‑Verify, please visit: www.e‑verify.gov We seek:

Individuals who have a “let me try” attitude and are resilient, present an opinion/position, justify it, and then accept whatever decision is made and charge forward

Individuals who think and create, enhancing the company with a steady flow of fresh ideas, perspective, and energy. jobs.title: Controls & Automation Technician
jobs.description:
Job description:

Hydro Extrusions is a world-leading aluminium extrusion business counting around 100 production sites in 40 countries and employing 20,000 people. Through our unique combination of local expertise, global network, and unmatched R&D capabilities, we can offer everything from standards profiles to advanced development and manufacturing for most industries.  Since 1905, Hydro has turned natural resources into valuable products for people and businesses with focus on a safe and good workplace for our 30,000 employees in more than 140 locations.
What we offer you
Medical, Rx, Dental, Disability, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts
Retirement Savings Plans with Company Match/Contributions
Education Assistance
Bonus Plan Eligibility
Parental Leave

Starting Rate of Pay: $39/hr-$46/hr
+$1.50 for night shift differential.
Shifts Available and Hours: 3rd Shift, Monday-Friday
11:00PM - 7:00AM
What you will be doing
Essential Job Responsibilities: 

Perform intermediate programming and safety configuration of PLC-controlled systems.
Independently develop, modify, and troubleshoot PLC logic using standard programming languages (e.g., ladder logic and function block).
Independently perform installation, programming, and troubleshooting of PLC systems in industrial environments with minimal supervision.
Troubleshoot and repair PLC-controlled systems and related components.
Integrate PLCs with HMIs, sensors, and actuators.
Collaborate with engineering teams on system upgrades and improvements.
Train junior technicians and provide technical support.
Utilize predictive measures to enhance equipment reliability through Continuous Reliability Improvement (CRI) initiatives.
Implement and support continuous reliability improvement standards and practices.
This position is a multi-craft role and will be required to support mechanical technicians as needed, approximately 30% of the time in role.
Respond to equipment breakdowns and other suddenly developed conditions requiring immediate action to restore operations

What will make you successful?
Required Education/Experience:  

3-5 years of hands-on professional experience independently programming, troubleshooting and supporting PLC-controlled equipment.
Demonstrated ability to independently modify, troubleshoot, and validate PLC ladder logic to support equipment enhancements, process improvements, and operational reliability.

Preferred Skills/Qualifications:  

Experience in Ladder logic programming in Allen Bradley Logix/Studio 5000 Software.
Proficient in programming User defined Tags, Add-on instructions, and Structured text programming. 
Experience with industrial communication protocols (e.g. Ethernet/IP). 
Experience in editing HMI applications in Factory talk view studio. 

Equal opportunities Hydro in North America is an Equal Opportunity Employer where all phases of employment are based strictly upon the qualifications of the individual as related to the work requirements of the position. This policy is applied without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, marital status or any other category protected by law. We strive to provide equal opportunities for all to contribute and succeed with us.
If you need an accommodation in order to complete the application, please contact Hydro Recruiting via email at recruiting.north.america@hydro.com

new_jobs.title: Controls & Automation Technician
new_jobs.description:
Job description:

Hydro Extrusions is a world-leading aluminium extrusion business counting around 100 production sites in 40 countries and employing 20,000 people. Through our unique combination of local expertise, global network, and unmatched R&D capabilities, we can offer everything from standards profiles to advanced development and manufacturing for most industries.  Since 1905, Hydro has turned natural resources into valuable products for people and businesses with focus on a safe and good workplace for our 30,000 employees in more than 140 locations.
What we offer you
Medical, Rx, Dental, Disability, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts
Retirement Savings Plans with Company Match/Contributions
Education Assistance
Bonus Plan Eligibility
Parental Leave

Starting Rate of Pay: $39/hr-$46/hr
+$1.50 for night shift differential.
Shifts Available and Hours: 3rd Shift, Monday-Friday
11:00PM - 7:00AM
What you will be doing
Essential Job Responsibilities: 

Perform intermediate programming and safety configuration of PLC-controlled systems.
Independently develop, modify, and troubleshoot PLC logic using standard programming languages (e.g., ladder logic and function block).
Independently perform installation, programming, and troubleshooting of PLC systems in industrial environments with minimal supervision.
Troubleshoot and repair PLC-controlled systems and related components.
Integrate PLCs with HMIs, sensors, and actuators.
Collaborate with engineering teams on system upgrades and improvements.
Train junior technicians and provide technical support.
Utilize predictive measures to enhance equipment reliability through Continuous Reliability Improvement (CRI) initiatives.
Implement and support continuous reliability improvement standards and practices.
This position is a multi-craft role and will be required to support mechanical technicians as needed, approximately 30% of the time in role.
Respond to equipment breakdowns and other suddenly developed conditions requiring immediate action to restore operations

What will make you successful?
Required Education/Experience:  

3-5 years of hands-on professional experience independently programming, troubleshooting and supporting PLC-controlled equipment.
Demonstrated ability to independently modify, troubleshoot, and validate PLC ladder logic to support equipment enhancements, process improvements, and operational reliability.

Preferred Skills/Qualifications:  

Experience in Ladder logic programming in Allen Bradley Logix/Studio 5000 Software.
Proficient in programming User defined Tags, Add-on instructions, and Structured text programming. 
Experience with industrial communication protocols (e.g. Ethernet/IP). 
Experience in editing HMI applications in Factory talk view studio.

This policy is applied without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, marital status or any other category protected by law. We strive to provide equal opportunities for all to contribute and succeed with us.
